svg.title: KCL workers, leases and checkpoints
svg.desc: KCL workers each own some shards through leases stored in DynamoDB and checkpoint their position there. A new worker triggers a rebalance, and a failed worker's shard is taken over by another.
svg.text: 1 Each KCL worker owns some shards: one worker per shard at a time. Ownership is a lease stored in DynamoDB
2 Workers checkpoint their position in DynamoDB, so a restart resumes where it stopped
3 A new worker joins: shards are rebalanced across the workers
4 A worker fails: its leases expire and another worker takes over its shard
